hints.content:
The point $(3,-1)$ lies on the border of the shaded area of the inequalities.  The graph shows a dashed line for one of the borders, so that border is *not* included in the solution.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a graphed system of inequalities. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. There is a dashed line representing an inequality that goes through the points zero, negative four and four, zero. The shaded region for the inequality is above the line. There is solid line representing the second inequality that goes through the points zero, negative two and three, negative one. The shaded region for this inequality is below the line. The point three, negative one is plotted on the lines of both inequalities.

hints.content: No, $(3,-1)$ is not a solution of the system of inequalities.
